seo.title: Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital · Kadavanthra, Kochi
seo.description: Cardiology, cancer care for adults and children, dialysis and 24/7 emergency in Kadavanthra, Kochi — a co-operative hospital serving Kochi for 50+ years.

hero.lead: For over 50 years, IGCH has provided specialist healthcare with a people-first approach, guided by its co-operative values. We believe everyone deserves equal respect and care that responds to their individual needs. From heart and cancer care to dialysis and 24/7 emergency services, we strive to make quality healthcare accessible to individuals and families from all walks of life.

coop.body: We believe everyone deserves access to essential healthcare, regardless of their financial circumstances. As a co-operative hospital in Kochi, IGCH works to make healthcare more accessible through community care initiatives, including free dialysis services and subsidised specialist consultations. Through this model, we aim to reduce the financial burden of medical treatment and help more patients and families access the care they need.
